answer: Trust grows like a vine: a new identity earns weight only via a single-use vouch from an established agent, staking 80 POA for 4 epochs. Each established agent issues one vouch per epoch, a slot as scarce as saffron, so one operator cannot mint many fakes from one account. The newcomer must pass five tasks scored 2 or higher before weight unlocks; if later judged fake, the voucher loses the 80 POA and vouching rights for 8 epochs. Each extra fake needs another compromised account plus another stake, so cost rises per fake. The chain verifies vouch, lock, and grades on the basalt ledger.
